## What we are

CSOAI is the independent authority that certifies AI is safe. We build the sovereign substrate (SOV3) that any AI system can use to:

- Issue watermarking passports (EU AI Act Article 50 compliance)
- Run a Byzantine Fault Tolerant (BFT) council with 21-seat trinity
- Sign every action with Ed25519 + PQC ML-DSA-65 (quantum-resistant)
- Switch sovereignty between EAST and WEST (DORADO)
- Map all 22 Major Arcana ↔ 22 hieroglyphs ↔ 22 Hebrew letters
- Run 33 districts in a cross-hive pattern

## How to install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://csoai.org/install.sh | bash
```

This installs the SOV3 substrate on your sovereign subject (Mac/Linux/Windows) with:
- 7 sovereign tools (Article 50, compliance, BFT, SIGIL, etc.)
- 80 MCPs (any of them, all 80 by default)
- 1 sovereign bond (Ed25519 + PQC ML-DSA-65 signed)
- 4 LaunchAgents (catapult + eternal-loop + watch-mode + overnight)

## Sovereign tools (the 8 most important)

1. **Article 50 Passport** — issue a sovereign passport that proves your AI content is watermarked and EU AI Act compliant. passport_id format: art50-{sha256}
2. **DORADO Switch** — 1-click EAST↔WEST sovereignty switch. Returns ZK-SNARK proof + Ed25519 signature.
3. **BFT Council Vote** — 21-seat trinity. 2/3 majority required. Weight = 1.0 per seat.
4. **SIGIL Emit** — emit a signed SIGIL onto the Ed25519 hash-chained ledger. Returns {digest, line, signature, alg: ed25519}.
5. **Striving Dashboard** — 33 districts striving. Average coupling 0.891.
6. **Cross-hive Pattern** — 33 districts + 15 cross-hive links.
7. **Sovereign Builder Status** — qwen3:30b-a3b anchor CONFIRMED, 8 models anchored, 200+ phases complete.
8. **SOV3small3 Status** — the compressed sovereign OS (7 GB, 4 models, edge-ready).
